weaknesses.title: SETMATCH is first-match only — no multi-claim / no CAS
weaknesses.detail: claim() replaces only the first exact free token. Claiming N slots needs N process runs. Concurrent agents race on the same first field with no atomic compare-and-swap or flock; last writer wins on WRITE. No O_EXCL lock plate.
weaknesses.repro: seed 4; two parallel claim → both may rewrite same first idle if interleaved before WRITE

weaknesses.title: No native repeat-N / FOR range — seed uses unrolled IF ladder
weaknesses.detail: Seeding N idle tokens required either EACH over a prebuilt marker bag or 32 unrolled IF n_match > k PUSH. No FOR i=1..N, no REPEAT n. Agents invent marker bags or cap capacity.
weaknesses.repro: action seed ARG1=4 builds markers via IF ladder then EACH LINE PUSH idle

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH empty new leaves blank field hole
weaknesses.detail: SETMATCH bag idle "" succeeds with LAST_N=1 and inserts an empty line. COUNTLINE idle drops but LINES still counts the hole. Easy to create silent capacity ghosts.
weaknesses.repro: rewritex idle "" → bag starts with empty field (cat -A shows $ alone)

weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE/HASLINE/SETMATCH exact-field only — status suffixes need pure tokens
weaknesses.detail: Bag peer:idle\nidle; COUNTLINE idle → 1 (not 2). Real rosters with name:status cannot use COUNTLINE on status alone without GREP/EACH first. Forces pure-token pool design or GREP then count.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON pool yields idleidleidlebusyidle — agents cannot recover slot order from JSON; must READ plate file.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: seed 2 → b'idle\nidle' ends_with_nl False. Hosts that APPEND glue last field to next write.

weaknesses.title: SYS NUM only parses LAST — seed count needs PREPEND/HEAD shuttle
weaknesses.detail: ARG1 count arrives as string. Cannot SYS NUM A; must PREPEND "" A; HEAD LAST; NUM. Same shuttle as prior runbook index ops.

weaknesses.title: SYS STR is itoa not string-format — report glue is PUSH bag only
weaknesses.detail: Attempted SYS STR "action=" ACTION failed with unknown form. STR coerces numbers to decimal strings; free-form report lines need REPLACEALL templates or PUSH key/value bags.
weaknesses.repro: SYS STR "action=" ACTION → parse error unknown form

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH miss soft LAST_N=0 without FAIL sticky unless agent adds FAIL
weaknesses.detail: Program must FAIL+CLEAR_ERR+REQUIRE discipline. Soft miss alone leaves OK green in -s unless FAIL used. Consistent with other soft bag ops but easy to miss in agent code.
weaknesses.repro: release on all-idle with REQUIRE=0 → miss=1 exit 0

workarounds: Use pure status tokens (idle/busy/done) not name:status when COUNTLINE/SETMATCH by status
Claim N times in host loop; do not expect multi-claim in one run
REQUIRE=1 + FAIL for hard miss exits; CLEAR_ERR after soft FAIL
Build reports as PUSH key/value bags or REPLACEALL templates — never SYS STR as printf
READ plate file for order; never trust PRINT_JSON on multi-line bags
Avoid SETMATCH to empty unless intentionally creating blank fields
language_gaps: no FOR range or REPEAT n
no SYS NUM var — LAST-only numeric parse
no string concat / printf — STR is itoa only
issues_faced: First draft used SYS EQS hit 0 — unknown form; numeric IF hit == 0 required
Report builder used SYS STR as printf — STR is itoa only; rewritten to PUSH bag
REQUIRE miss test false green when one idle remained — harness order bug, not language
Seed N without loop forced unrolled IF marker ladder — painful agent code
Empty ARG2 for rewritex initially EXIT 2 on BLANK B — relaxed to surface blank-field hole
